brief_title: The Efficacy and Safety of Empagliflozin - Linagliptin and Empagliflozin- Metformin Therapy in Reduction of Body Weight in Type 2 Diabetic Patients .
official_title: Comparison of Empagliflozin- Linagliptin With Empagliflozin- Metformin Combination Therapy in Reduction of Body Weight in Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus

interventions.name: Tab Empagliflozin 10 mg + Tab Metformin 500 mg

arm_groups.label: Group B received Empagliflozin with Linagliptin

intervention_names: Drug: Tab Empagliflozin 10 mg + Tab Metformin 500 mg
arm_groups.label: Group A received Empagliflozin with Metformin

primary_outcomes.measure: Overall improvement in Fasting Blood Glucose
Overall change in Body Mass Index ( kg/m2)
Overall improvement in Random Blood Glucose
Over all improvement in Glycated Hemoglobin ( HbA1c)
Overall change in Waist to Hip Ratio

brief_summary: The goal of this clinical trial is - Comparison of Empagliflozin - Linagliptin with Empagliflozin - Metformin combination therapy in reduction of body weight in T2DM Patients and it included 200 diabetic subjects with total study period of 12 weeks and individual study period of 4 weeks .

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* • Diabetic men and women of age 40-70 yrs.

  * HBA1C -(6.5-9 )percent
  * All diabetic patients were BMI ≥25kg/m2
  * Patient took metformin ≥1000mg/day for ≥ 3 months with uncontrolled DM

Exclusion Criteria:

* Male and female type 1 diabetic patients with BMI \<25

  * Diabetic patient taking oral medicine other than metformin for last 12 weeks
  * Subjects with creatinine \>1.5mg/dl
  * Pregnant or Lactating Women
  * Co-morbidities -
  * CLD
  * Cancer patient
